heard: 2 He sat by the well in the land of Midian, and seven daughters came to fill the troughs. 3 Shepherds drove them away in the heat, and Moses rose up to water their flock. We will ask why they returned so soon An Egyptian had rescued their day Invite him to eat, said the father Zipporah became his wife that way Blessed be the Lord who rescued you From the hand of Pharaoh and Egypt Now I know the Lord is with me
